title: Server 404s on an issue it created a moment earlier
why: Pre-existing issues update fine. The bug only shows up on the create-then-edit path, and the UI quietly reverts to Backlog with no error.
finding: `POST /api/issues` → 201 `{id:"i1781307989927"}`, then `PATCH /api/issues/i1781307989927` → 404 for that same id. A control `PATCH /api/issues/i4` returned 200.
actual: The PATCH /api/issues/i1781307989927 request (body {"status":"todo"}) returns HTTP 404 with body {"error":"not found"}, even though the create call POST /api/issues returned 201 with response body {"id":"i1781307989927","status":"backlog"}. The Status combobox reverts to 'Backlog', the issue is not triaged, and it still renders in the Inbox after the failure.
expected: Selecting a new Status for the newly-created issue should persist: the backend PATCH should succeed, the issue's status should become Todo, and the issue should leave the Inbox triage list, exactly as it does for pre-existing issues.

chronology.text: In the ENG-149 detail dialog (ENG-149 was just created via the New issue dialog; the create call POST /api/issues returned 201 with id i1781307989927), the user opens the 'Status' dropdown and clicks the 'Todo' option to triage the issue out of the Inbox. The Status field still reads 'Backlog' at the moment of selection. This click fires the status-update PATCH request. _User interaction._

reproduce.text: Open the Linear app and click 'Inbox' in the sidebar (the 'Triage new issues' view).
Click 'New issue', type a title (e.g. 'QA triage test issue') and click 'Create issue'. The issue is created as ENG-149 with status Backlog and appears in the Inbox.
Click the new ENG-149 row to open its detail dialog.
Open the 'Status' dropdown and select 'Todo' to triage it.
Observe the Status snaps back to 'Backlog' and the issue stays in the Inbox.

rootCause.text: The backend returns HTTP 404 with body {"error":"not found"} for PATCH /api/issues/i1781307989927 (request body {"status":"todo"}), even though the same backend created that exact issue: the create call POST /api/issues returned 201 with response body {"id":"i1781307989927","identifier":"ENG-149","status":"backlog"}. The issue was not removed by any delete (cross-run or otherwise): immediately after the 404 the Inbox still renders ENG-149. In the same session, PATCH /api/issues/i4 on a pre-existing issue returns 200 and updates its status to 'todo', so the update endpoint itself works. The 404 'not found' for an id the server itself issued directly contradicts the server's own create (201) response and the observable application state — a server-side defect that makes newly-created issues un-updatable and therefore un-triageable.
